items.title: Higher rates could be needed to avoid 'inflationary mindset' taking hold, says Fed's Hammack
items.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said Monday that tighter monetary policy might be needed to bring down inflation and the central bank should make fast, incremental adjustments.

items.title: Inflation likely peaked for 2026 but will remain sticky, according to prediction markets
items.summary: Traders on prediction market platform Kalshi think inflation likely reached a peak for the year, though they don't see a sharp move lower anytime soon.

items.title: India’s retail inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, above estimates
items.summary: India's headline inflation rose to 5.54% in September from 4.82% in August , adding pressure on the country's central bank to further tighten monetary policy.
